quotes.text: In this TB Tools repair case, a published repair was reported to have passed Try, but the current clean checkout still had both old #password selectors and did not contain the repair commit. A prior successful Try for another commit therefore did not make this checkout already fixed or ready for a matching-source Try. Compare the current source and commit ancestry before reporting repair status; this lesson applies when a related worker published a repair outside the checkout being assessed.

source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.
